comment: A piece of content (introduction, lecture, announcement, ...) belonging to a course.

columns.name: campus_id
columns.comment: Campus this course content belongs to.

columns.name: course_id
columns.comment: Course this content item belongs to.

columns.name: content_type
columns.comment: Kind of content this is (e.g. Introduction, Lecture, Announcement) -- references course_content_type.code.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Surrogate identifier for the course content, auto-generated by the database and unique across the whole system.

columns.name: ordering_position
columns.comment: Explicit display order of this content item, independent of id or content_type.

columns.name: active
columns.comment: Whether this content item is currently shown.

columns.name: document_text
columns.comment: Optional body text for this content item, capped at 4000 characters (SQL Server's largest non-MAX NVARCHAR size) rather than using the unbounded text type.
